facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Engineering in materials engineering at Fictional Ashcell University in 2016.
facts.zh: 2016 年在虚构白蜡格大学获得材料工程工学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid packaging test assistant at Fictional Reedbuffer Products from 2016-09 to 2019-04.
facts.zh: 2016-09 至 2019-04 在虚构芦缓产品公司任有薪包装测试助理。

facts.en: Paid packaging development engineer at Fictional Honeycombspan Devices from 2019-05 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2019-05 至 2026-08 在虚构蜂窝跨设备公司任有薪包装开发工程师。

facts.en: Designs corrugated inserts for small nonhazardous devices using approved product dimensions and handling requirements.
facts.zh: 依据获批产品尺寸及搬运要求，为小型非危险设备设计瓦楞插衬。

facts.en: Creates CAD cut patterns and assembly drawings for prototype samples.
facts.zh: 为原型样品制作 CAD 裁切图样及装配图。

facts.en: Plans internal drop and vibration trials using the company’s approved test procedure and records sample conditions.
facts.zh: 依据公司获批测试程序规划内部跌落及振动试验，并记录样品状态。

facts.en: Has delegated authority to approve insert drawing revisions within an existing approved material specification.
facts.zh: 经授权，可在现有获批材料规格范围内批准插衬图纸修订。

facts.en: The quality manager approves material-specification changes and external certification claims.
facts.zh: 质量经理批准材料规格变更及外部认证声明。

facts.en: Led an insert redesign trial for a 2025-05 device package with a technician and purchasing colleague.
facts.zh: 2025-05 与一名技术员及一名采购同事共同参与设备包装插衬重新设计试验，由候选人牵头。

facts.en: Personally designed the folded geometry and wrote the trial protocol; the technician ran the scheduled machine tests.
facts.zh: 个人设计折叠几何结构并编写试验方案；技术员运行计划内机器测试。

facts.en: Across 2 prototype rounds, 24 package samples were tested, with 12 samples in each round.
facts.zh: 在 2 轮原型试验中测试 24 个包装样品，每轮 12 个。

facts.en: Round 2 recorded no visible device damage in its 12 samples; the report did not estimate a field failure rate.
facts.zh: 第 2 轮记录其 12 个样品中的设备均无可见损坏；报告未估计现场失效率。

facts.en: A project note estimates a 7% reduction in insert material mass, but omits the weighing records and whether the comparison used equal sample sizes.
facts.zh: 一份项目备注估计插衬材料质量减少 7%，但未附称量记录，也未说明比较是否使用相同样本量。

facts.en: Uses CAD drawing tools, spreadsheet test summaries and controlled specification registers.
facts.zh: 使用 CAD 绘图工具、电子表格测试摘要及受控规格登记册。

facts.en: Reviews supplier prototype questions and records deviations requiring quality-manager approval.
facts.zh: 审核供应商原型问题，并记录需要质量经理批准的偏差。

facts.en: Completed internal packaging-test equipment orientation in 2019-06.
facts.zh: 2019-06 完成内部包装测试设备入门培训。

facts.en: Explains approved insert assembly steps to production trainers using annotated samples.
facts.zh: 使用带注释样品向生产培训人员解释获批插衬装配步骤。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Foldforest Craft Club, helping adults make paper storage organizers.
facts.zh: 在虚构折林手工社做志愿者，协助成年人制作纸质收纳用品。

facts.en: Made a personal modular cardboard desk tray in 2024 and shared the pattern free with club members.
facts.zh: 2024 年制作个人模块化纸板桌面托盘，并向社团成员免费分享图样。

facts.en: The personal tray was not tested for commercial transport or sold as protective packaging.
facts.zh: 个人托盘未经商业运输测试，也未作为保护性包装销售。

facts.en: Enjoys geometric paper folding and drawing imaginary product boxes.
facts.zh: 爱好几何折纸及绘制想象中的产品盒。

facts.en: Maintains a change log linking approved drawing revisions to trial reports and released assembly instructions.
facts.zh: 维护变更日志，将获批图纸修订与试验报告及已发布装配说明关联。
